title: Dissatisfied
text: Dissatisfied. Me, long with 2 others, ordered these lights. The battery box has a place on the back of the board to hide the battery box. The battery box fit snug on the back of the board on 2 sets but fit VERY loose on the other set. I had to use dbl sided tape to make it stay. The light cords were silver in one order but copper in the others! Not a lot of effort was put into making these!! Very disappointed!! Even tho they didn’t cost that much the differences made them look cheap!!!
